# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
## Functionality
1. Record all property conditions found.
2. Include pictures of the conditions found.
3. Indicate whether the condition is needed and how long the property has been in violation.
4. Assign a date to the observations and record how the observations were made.
5. Include a description of the violation and the severity of the violation.
6. Include what to do if a "no-entry" violation is discovered.
7. Include other forms such as the "I will not re-enter the area" form.
8. SharePoint
9. ހެއްދެމެމަތި
10. އަންނަ ހުރަހަށް ކަމެއްކަމެއް ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދޫކޮށްލެވޭތޯ ދުވަހަށް މިިކީނެ ގާއިދުގާއި އެއްޗެހި ދެއްވ
